cli.title: loom - schema-driven systems-engineering model
cli.synopsis: loom <command> [options]   (every command takes --json to print the result envelope)

commonOptions.purpose: selects a document (the governing workspace still applies)

cli.exitStatus: 0 ok, 1 refusal or error finding, 2 usage error.

presenceRules.message: send exactly one of 'model' (an inline document) or 'workspace': true
presenceRules.fix: send 'model' for a pure calculation or 'workspace': true for the workspace model

presenceRules.message: the request must carry exactly one of 'patch' or 'patches'
presenceRules.fix: send one patch as 'patch' or a batch as 'patches'

presenceRules.message: a persistent workspace mutation names the base revision it was prepared against
presenceRules.fix: send 'expectedRevision': the revision of the model the patch was prepared against

presenceRules.message: send 'before' and 'after', or 'againstBaseline': true with an inline 'after' or with 'workspace': true
inspect takes 'path' and an optional 'boundary', and nothing else
presenceRules.fix: send 'path', and 'boundary' to limit how far inspection reads

presenceRules.message: initialize takes 'path', 'declaration' and 'dryRun', and 'expectedInspection' when it writes
an initialization that writes names the inspection it was prepared against
presenceRules.fix: send 'expectedInspection': the inspection digest inspect returned

presenceRules.message: open takes 'path' and 'access', and an optional 'view'
status and close take only the 'workspaceId' that open returned
presenceRules.fix: send the 'workspaceId' of a handle this session opened

presenceRules.message: plan takes 'changes' and the 'expectedVector' they were prepared against
apply takes the 'proposalId' a plan returned and the 'expectedVector' it was planned against

presenceRules.fix: send 'workspaceId', and 'snapshotDigest' to check another snapshot than the current one
send the check ids, the target, the revision vector to qualify and the execution policy name
